title: Map labelling #10
topic: wildlife park · museum · university campus · botanical garden
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The wildlife park.
Guide: Welcome to the wildlife park. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the reptile house. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the picnic area. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the penguin pool. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The butterfly house is directly behind the reptile house, at the back of the site.
Guide: The petting farm is directly behind the penguin pool, at the back of the site.
Guide: The gift shop is right next to the butterfly house, on its left side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The museum.
Guide: Welcome to the museum. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the temporary exhibition is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the archive room. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the cinema is the first building on your left.
Guide: The maritime gallery is directly behind the archive room, at the back of the site.
Guide: The cloakroom is directly behind the cinema, at the back of the site.
Guide: The costume gallery is right next to the maritime gallery, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The university campus.
Guide: Welcome to the university campus. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the student union. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the science block. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the bike shed is the first building on your left.
Guide: The health centre is directly behind the student union, at the back of the site.
Guide: The library is directly behind the bike shed, at the back of the site.
Guide: The bookshop is in the middle at the back, between the library and the health centre.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the souvenir stall. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the play area. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the herb garden is the first building on your left.
Guide: The cactus house is directly behind the herb garden, at the back of the site.
Guide: The tea room is directly behind the play area, at the back of the site.
Guide: The sculpture lawn is right next to the tea room, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
